mechanism.channel: ChannelArtifact directory with hash-verified Q.npz and manifest.json
mechanism.encoder: pinned frozen T0 encoder joblib file, verified against channel manifest encoder_sha256 before deserialization

private_emit_input_npz.x_a: finite PCA32 allowed A inputs, N by 32
private_emit_input_npz.h_a: finite four-coordinate historical A service, N by 4; bytes are preserved
private_emit_input_npz.release_ids: one-dimensional unique caller-held nonempty strings or integers, length N; never emitted

private_key.format: raw file containing at least 32 secret bytes, mode 0600
private_key.retention: caller retains same key privately across process restarts; never bundle with public channel or wire

wire_output_npz.h_a: same shape, dtype and bytes as private input h_a
wire_output_npz.token: one sampled integer in [0,16] per original person, length N

query_scope: one computationally pseudorandom token per immutable person/input/channel/key; no repeated-independent-draw or composition guarantee
evaluation: Exact expected-token losses are computed internally across all 17 tokens; they are not released on the wire
platform: Historical frozen encodings are scientific inputs from verified Linux x86; Mac re-encoding is not interchangeable for historical comparisons
